key.name: upload-backend
key.description: 'blossom' uses BUD-02 PUT with BUD-01 nostr-auth against upload-server-url; 'nostr.build' uses the legacy NIP-96-style multipart endpoint (currently returns 405 upstream).

key.name: upload-max-mb
key.description: Files larger than this are refused before any network I/O. 0 disables the local gate (server limits still apply).

key.name: proxy-enabled
key.summary: Route network traffic through a SOCKS5 proxy
key.description: When true, relay connections, LNURL/NIP-11 lookups and media fetches go through the SOCKS5 proxy below (e.g. a local tor daemon). No silent clearnet fallback: an unreachable proxy is a visible error.

key.name: proxy-host
key.description: Inside a Flatpak the sandbox loopback is not the host's; point this at the tor SocksPort address reachable from the sandbox (often the podman gateway IP, e.g. 10.0.0.1).

key.name: proxy-remote-dns
key.description: Must stay true whenever .onion endpoints are used: the hostname is sent to the proxy verbatim and never touches a local DNS resolver.

key.name: media-resilience
key.summary: Recover dead content-addressed media via the author's Blossom servers
key.description: When a media URL ending in a 64-character sha256 fails to load, gnostr asks the media author's Blossom server list (kind 10063) for the blob and only displays it after the downloaded bytes hash to the URL's sha256. Disable to keep broken links broken.

key.name: feed-collapse-chars
key.summary: Characters shown before a feed post collapses
key.description: Feed cards collapse posts longer than this behind a 'Show more' button. 0 disables collapsing. The cut never splits a link or mention.

key.name: nwc-connection-label
key.description: Display name for the configured NWC wallet connection (e.g. 'Phone wallet'). The connection URI lives in the keyring, not here.

key.name: monthly-zap-budget-sats
key.description: Client soft cap: the app blocks zap confirmations once the calendar month's recorded spend plus the next zap exceeds this. The wallet service enforces its own hard cap at connection mint time; keep this at or below it.
